conventions.csv: RFC 4180, comma delimiter, UTF-8 without BOM, one header row.
conventions.dates: document_date is an ISO 8601 date; date_expression keeps the source spelling.
conventions.ids: description_id is opaque and stable within one installation; do not parse it.
conventions.language: language_name is the label the archive declared, not a normalized BCP 47 tag.
conventions.multivalue: arrays in JSON and NDJSON; the same JSON array encoded in one CSV cell.
conventions.null: an absent value is null in JSON and an empty cell in CSV.

fields.description: Stable identifier of the description within the installation; opaque, not a URL.
fields.name: description_id

fields.description: The title as the source declared it.
fields.name: original_title

fields.description: The curator-corrected title, when one was written.
fields.name: final_title

fields.description: The normalized date (ISO 8601 date), when the pipeline could parse one.
fields.name: document_date

fields.description: The date as the source spelled it, e.g. '1910-1950'.
fields.name: date_expression

fields.description: Display name of the arrangement rung; the archivist may rename it.
fields.name: level

fields.description: Stable catalogue key of the rung; group by this, not by 'level'.
fields.name: level_code

fields.description: Extent and medium of the unit of description.
fields.name: dimension_support

fields.description: Language of the material, as the archive declared it.
fields.name: language_name

fields.description: Conditions governing access; descriptive, not the diffusion gate.
fields.name: access_conditions

fields.description: Diplomatic form from the typology catalogue (ata, ofício, planta…).
fields.name: typology

fields.description: Subject terms; an array of {tag_id, name}.
fields.name: tags

fields.description: Named entities; an array of {entity_id, name, entity_type}.
fields.name: entities

fields.description: Majority vote over the tags; an array of {category_id, name, tag_count}.
fields.name: macro_categories

fields.description: The branch, root first; an array of {description_id, title, level, level_code}.
fields.name: ancestors

fields.description: How many descriptions hang directly under this one.
fields.name: children_count
